description: This file defines the Goteo\Core\DB class, which extends PDO to manage database connections, including master and replica configurations, caching, and query statistics within the Goteo project.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A database handler class extending PDO, managing master and replica connections, caching, and query statistics.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database connections, including optional read replica, and sets PDO attributes.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares SQL statements, routing select queries to replica if enabled.

methods.name: getQueryStats
methods.description: Returns statistics on executed queries, both cached and non-cached.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Static method to activate or check the status of internal SQL cache globally.

methods.name: replica
methods.description: Static method to activate or check the status of read replica usage globally.
